thread:
Taylor: Quick sync  discovered a few glossary mismatches while reviewing the migration guide. We have three different terms used for the same concept: \"request routing policy\", \"routing-policy\", and \"Routing Policy\". Can we pick a canonical form for code vs prose?
Nina: Thanks for flagging. My vote: use kebab-case (routing-policy) in config and code samples, and Title Case (Routing policy) in headings, and plain prose as \"routing policy\". Keeps it readable.
Priya: Agreed. Also please add an alias entry in the glossary so search finds old variants. Someone ran into this when searching for \"routing policy\" and got no hits.
Taylor: Good call on aliases. Example for the glossary entry: `routing-policy` (primary), aliases: `routing policy`, `Routing Policy`, `request routing policy`. Priya: can you add that?
Priya: Yep, I'll open a tiny PR to /docs/glossary.md. I'll include the alias list and a one-liner: \"Controls how requests are routed across model variants and regions.\"
DocsBot: note: docs search index will need a reindex after merges. Queueing reindex task.
Lee: While we're at it, a handful of SDK snippets still use the old function name `setRoutingPolicy`. Newer SDK uses `configure-routing`. We should add a migration note in the guide with a before/after snippet.
Taylor: Good catch. Suggest a micro migration section under the migration guide with a code diff. Something like:
```
# before
client.setRoutingPolicy({ strategy: 'latency' })

# after
client.configure-routing({ 'routing-policy': 'latency' })
```
Nina: Also saw a broken internal link on the migration page: `/docs/migrate#routing` -> should be `/docs/migrate#routing-policy`. I'll file a tiny link-fix PR.
Priya: I'll update the glossary entry and add the migration snippet. Will ping for review.
Lee: I'll update one JS snippet I own and add a short comment to explain param-case for new readers.
Taylor: Can we add a one-line rule in /docs/style.md under \"naming\" saying: \"Use param-case (kebab-case) for config keys and inline code; use sentence-case for prose.\" Keep it short.
Nina: I'll make the style.md PR and include an example. Also add a checkbox to the docs PR template: \"I verified parameter naming follows docs style (param-case for config)\".
DocsBot: automated check reminder: docs-snippet-test flagged 2 examples with `setRoutingPolicy`. Those will fail CI until updated.
Taylor: Plan: Priya updates glossary + migration snippet, Nina updates style guide + PR template, Lee + I sweep owned snippets, Priya or Nina will trigger search reindex after merges. Aim to get this done today. :thumbsup:
Priya: on it. Opening PRs now.
Nina: will draft style blurb and template patch.
Lee: starting snippet updates.
DocsBot: reindex job queued after detected merges.
